note: The pinned sources of gen_x86sys.py. Trust chain (CLAUDE.md rule 7): documented Win32 (WDK 7.1 headers, MSDN), the Intel SDM, and Wine 9.0 under the owner's Wine rule. No other source. WDK mirror: fnv-nx-build tools/wdk71-headers (MANIFEST.json there records the ISO, cab and msi hashes). gen_x86sys.py checks the sha256 of every file it reads against this record.

cpumodel.origin: the declared CPU's cpuid as data (CPUREF: verify/cpuref.json + verify/cpuid_model.json); lift/rt/cpumodel.c is generated from it, not a source

precedence: (1) documented Win32 for Windows 7 SP1 build 7601: MSDN and WDK 7.1
(2) Wine 9.0, only where it contradicts neither (1) nor the declared OS
(3) nothing else (ReactOS is not a source)

doc_gates.source: MSDN __fastfail intrinsic: fast fail is supported from Windows 8 (build 9200); Windows 7 SP1 is build 7601, so int 0x29 is not a fast-fail gate there. What the instruction does on build 7601 is not stated by MSDN: undecided
